name: media-analysis
description: Deterministic media observation / analysis. Measures facts about media files; never interprets, decides or edits.

tools.description: Audio format of one audio stream (sample rate, channels, layout, codec, sample format, bitrate)
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Applause and laughter spans of one audio stream from an audio-event classifier (optional extra 'events'; UNKNOWN without it): time ranges with a score
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Full decode with error counting, per-stream frame counts and timestamp monotonicity; PASS / WARN / FAIL
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness, loudness range and true peak of one audio stream
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Noise floor, signal level and no-reference SNR estimate of one audio stream (or one channel) from short-window RMS
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Picture facts per window, not judged: sharpness (blurdetect), luma mean / 10th / 90th percentile (signalstats), camera jitter and speed from block-median frame shifts
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Container and primary stream facts (format, duration, size, bitrate, video/audio summary)
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Deterministic visual scene-cut detection (scdet score), not semantic scene understanding
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Highlight signals measured, not judged: speech-energy peaks, speaking-rate changes and screen-change bursts, each as time ranges with a score
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Silence segments of one audio stream with leading / internal / trailing classification
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Every stream with index, type, codec, language, disposition, dimensions, rate, channels
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Editing-style profile: cut rate and shot-length distribution, soft and burned-in subtitle frequency / coverage / position, loudness and silence share
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Duration and timing facts: start times, per-stream durations, A/V duration mismatch and start offset, timestamp discontinuities
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Speech regions of one audio stream from a voice-activity model (optional extra 'vad'; UNKNOWN without it): time ranges with probability, speech share, longest pause
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

tools.description: Video format of one video stream (resolution, fps, frame count, pixel format, colour, SAR/DAR, CFR/VFR)
tools.input_type: media file path (one file per request)

execution.stdin: AnalysisRequest JSON (UTF-8) when the request argument is '-'
execution.stdout: exactly one response document (response schema) when --json is given; always UTF-8, independent of the console / pipe encoding
execution.stderr: diagnostics only; never part of the contract
execution.executable_resolution: PATH lookup only; not configurable through the request or the CLI

events.model: YAMNet (Apache-2.0), converted to ONNX and shipped in the package

analysis_id.description: caller's id; derived from the analysis identity when omitted

asset_id.description: caller's label for the asset; echoed, not part of the identity

input.description: path of one media file (absolute, or relative to the process working directory)

parameters.description: kind-specific parameters; unknown names, wrong types and out-of-range values are INVALID_INPUT

cache_policy.description: use: read and write; bypass: never read or write; only: read, CACHE_MISS when absent

batch.title: media-analysis request batch
batch.description: Document accepted by `media-analysis run`: a single AnalysisRequest, a list of them, or this batch envelope.

plan.description: dry-run only: analyzer, capabilities and operations that would run

class.description: retry guidance: FATAL never retry unchanged; RETRYABLE bounded retry may succeed; BLOCKED environment / budget must change

response.title: media-analysis response
response.description: stdout document of `media-analysis run ... --json` (also used for `analyze` / `probe` with --json)

status.description: ok: every result ok; partial: some; error: none (or the batch itself was rejected)

observations.description: observations of the ok results, in request order

class.description: retry guidance: FATAL never retry unchanged; RETRYABLE bounded retry may succeed; BLOCKED environment / budget must change

data.description: measured values only; finite numbers; no command / argv keys

analyzer_version.description: package version that measured this observation (provenance; == the version in source)

algorithm_version.description: the analyzer's measurement version; enters the identity and the cache key instead of the package version

budget.exceeded: BUDGET_EXCEEDED, no observation, no analyzer process

class_semantics.FATAL: terminal: retrying the unchanged request rejects identically
class_semantics.RETRYABLE: a bounded retry of the same request may succeed
class_semantics.BLOCKED: the environment (executable, filter) or the caller's budget must change first
